A luxury hotel in County Antrim, Dunadry Hotel & Gardens offers the perfect blend of history, comfort, and countryside charm. Nestled on the banks of the Six Mile River, this former linen mill has been transformed into one of Northern Ireland’s most unique and character-filled places to stay. Just 20 minutes from Belfast and close to major travel routes, our location makes an ideal base for exploring the sights of Antrim, the Causeway Coast, and beyond. Inside, you’ll find 72 stylish bedrooms ranging from Classic to Executive and Suites – each designed with rest and relaxation in mind. So, Gavin just like our General Manager Malachy you are also a Member of Massereene Golf Club? Yes, I’m a member of Massereene Golf Club, I have been a member there since I was 8 years old. You are bound to have some amazing golf stories and achievements to tell us about? What are your most memorable achievements? When I was a junior, I represented ulster at junior level and competed in interprovincial tournaments. I have been twice club champion at Massereene golf club. My current playing handicap is 4, hopefully with a bit of practice I can get this down a bit. I also spent a few years caddying on the European challenge tour and a few European tour events. I was fortunate to get to travel to many beautiful parts of the world. My favourite of which being leopard creek in south Africa. There is an undeniable buzz about Northern Ireland now, what are you most excited about? It really is such an exciting time in Northern Ireland, with Massereene & Galgorm co-hosting the NI Open which is a joint challenge tour event, having secured great sponsorship. This is going to attract a really strong field. Having caddied at this event at Galgorm a few times, I am excited to see them playing at Massereene. It’s great for the local area. Also, The British open at Royal Portrush is going to be massive for tourism in NI. All the top players in the world will be here. I’ve played royal Portrush quite a few times. I remember playing the day Rory McIlroy shot a course record 61 as a 16 year old junior, what a score and it was clear he was going to go on to be the superstar golfer that he is. And, who will you be backing in The 148th Open? I’ll obviously be supporting Rory, but I would love to see Padraig Harrington do well. This stunningly unique hidden gem is seductively romantic for weddings. A former paper mill dating back to 1670’s, the hotel is full of original features married with a modern twist offering something for everyone to fall in love with and has recently become part of the Original Irish Hotels. The hotel & gardens lends itself perfectly to every season whatever your presence with the interior boasting the Grand Ballroom, The River Suite and The Gallery to the gardens having the tree of unity, river walk and of course the peacocks.
